precondition: Koios supplies one immutable manuscript, deterministic standards findings, its production run, the witnessed source records available to that run, and—when a gate failed—the operative assignments, skills, scripts, configuration, and prompting code that produced it.
move: LISS executes Koios's editorial and failed-pipeline-diagnosis instructions through one explicitly contracted leader-claude tier using claude-sonnet-4-6 and returns an accept, revise, or refuse judgment plus the earliest causal layer to improve and replay.
postcondition: Koios appends the judgment under data/editorial-judgments; publication is admissible only when deterministic standards are clear and the independent judgment says accept and publishable true.
authority: The Leader sets editorial law; routine manuscript judgment is delegated to Koios's editorial duty and performed by LISS without a per-article human gate.
